name: Upstash Redis

free_tier.notes: Free plan monthly command quota; max 10,000 commands/second
Free plan is limited to a single Redis database

notes: Perpetual free tier (not a trial), positioned for prototypes/hobby projects. No credit card needed to sign up; per official FAQ, entering a credit card upgrades the database to the pay-as-you-go plan. No sleep/idle shutdown behavior for Redis databases. Limits verified on official pricing page and docs on 2026-07-03. upstash.com/pricing now redirects to /pricing/redis (2026-08-15).
